designationHistory.indexText: Aroostook National Wildlife Refuge (NWR or refuge), located in the northeast corner of Maine, was established in 1998, when 4,700 acres was transferred from the US Air Force to the U.S.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Aroostook National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: 1998 transfer of former Loring Air Force Base land is repeated by tourism and campus pages, but all trace to the FWS wording. Confirm the transfer date and authority (16 U.S.C. 667b / base-closure transfer) from the Northern Maine refuges CCP or the transfer document.
